All the screens, and how they connect

Each column is a step of a call. Lines join a screen to the next step it opens; where a way in skips a step, the card says where it lands. Red dashed lines lose the person or lead nowhere.

Worst to best

Scored on the five questions you ask of every screen, two points each: is its purpose clear, does it earn its place, are the words plain, does it hold the design rules, and does it match the live call. The landing is not the lowest score, but it is the one Luke sees most, so it matters most.

First pass, 22 Oct 2026, rejected for its components

You kept its structure and rejected its parts: the raised round controls, the square tiles, the square fold, the list switch, the circle buttons in the top bar, the fonts and the sea-glass lines. It stays here for the record. The Studio replaces it.
